name: Ranged Versatility
body:
Prerequisite(s): Dragon pact kineticist, elemental ascetic, indomitable, kinetic duelist, kinetic knight, or kinetic lancer 1st

Benefit: You gain the ranged blast form infusion; this infusion can be applied to your kinetic blast regardless of the normal limitations of your archetype.
